model: SVM RBF, StandardScaler, C=1, gamma=scale, 128 features; original other settings
preprocessing: Unweighted median imputer and StandardScaler fitted only on each Train. Weights passed only to classifier. No feature selection or PCA.

formulas.time_recent: raw=c*t, t=1.75 for last two observed Train batches, else1

normalization: effective=raw/mean(raw); class multiplier*sample multiplier=effective; C_i=C*effective. u=ordinal rank among observed Train batches/(B-1), not elapsed time.
primary: Equal-weight mean of Fold macro F1

guards.evidence: Nonbaseline must reduce zero pairs OR improve mean macro F1 by at least .002

tie: Among guard-passing candidates and baseline, within .005 of best mean macro: fewer zero pairs, higher min recall, higher min(mean Toluene recall, mean Acetaldehyde recall), higher pooled macro, smaller Fold SD, fixed scheme order. Baseline retained if none pass.
range_comparison: Baseline Train1-6 vs1-7 on common Batch8; not a range selection. Candidate weighting also paired at both ranges. No evaluation of Train1-7 on Batch7.
evaluation_gate: Freeze candidate, selected model hashes and rules before any Batch9-10 predictions.
candidate_fallback: Keep original stage6 saved SVM bytes if no nonbaseline candidate passes guards.
